pages.text: $(bold)Heavenly Restriction: Tyrant$() — a binding sworn with heaven and earth through a self-damaging rite (Fushiguro Toji style): $(bold)permanently lose Cursed Energy$() in exchange for a body beyond all reason.$(br2)Conditions to trigger (all must be met):$(li)New moon night (moon phase 4, night 13000~23000)$(li)No open sky: the pool must be roofed over directly above$(li)Light level at the ritual spot < 8 (a dark room)$(li)Pool: 1 block deep, at least 9 connected water source blocks, with open space right above the pool's center$(br2)In Creative mode the time condition can be skipped for easier testing.

Within 16 blocks of the pool, prepare the altar materials:$(li)Netherrack ×7 or more$(li)Obsidian ×9 or more$(li)Soul Sand ×7 or more$(li)Nether Bricks ×9 or more$(li)Light $(bold)fire$() on the netherrack and $(bold)soul fire$() on the soul sand (at least 1 of each)$(br2)$(bold)Note$(): fire emits light — if it is too close to the pool it will break the "light level < 8" trigger, so keep the fires 8 blocks away or wall them off.

Steps:$(li)1. Gather the materials and light the fires$(li)2. Throw a $(bold)Wither Skeleton Skull$() into the pool water: the skull is drawn into the pool's center, spins for 3 seconds, then bursts apart as the pool turns black$(li)3. Jump into the black water: every 20 ticks the pool "heals −11% of max health" (direct damage that ignores armor and invulnerability frames), with heavy black block-break particles, until your health is down to just 1%$(li)4. Darkness falls and the center of the screen shows "Heavenly Restriction", "Body", "You have lost Cursed Energy" in turn; glass shattering and a wither spawn sound play$(li)5. The ritual completes: the pool drains, the fires go out, and your health recovers to 40% of the new maximum

After the ritual: the pool is drained and every fire is extinguished, and you gain $(bold)Heavenly Restriction (the Heavenly Tyrant)$():$(li)Loss of Cursed Energy: you can no longer wear a Cursed Energy Core (the curio slot is sealed), can no longer land Black Flashes (chance locked to 0), and your Cursed Energy drops to zero$(li)Body enhancement: max health $(bold)×5$(), movement speed $(bold)×5$(), jump height $(bold)×3$(), attack damage $(bold)×10$() (permanent attributes)$(br2)This state is $(bold)locked in$(): neither death nor relogging removes it, and any Cursed Energy Core forced in during this state is automatically taken off.$(br2)$(bold)Ritual detection$(): mutually exclusive with the "Cursed Energy" ritual — completing either binding ritual puts a mark on you, and while marked neither ritual can be held again; use the command $(bold)/tinkersnewlife unbind$() to clear the mark and restore your physique and attributes.
